title: Concept: WebView remote debugging enabled in java — review required
description: In java, WebView debugging is switched on unconditionally. The API exists for development, and Chrome inspection then exposes the live DOM and stored session material over adb. The setting is often added while diagnosing a rendering issue and left behind.
applicability: java Android applications that embed a WebView.
risk: Session and page-content exposure through the debug bridge; MEDIUM severity.
